releases.displayName: Winter Progress Update! Big News Soon!

items.text: Hello Survivors!
Since the holidays ended, we've been hunkering down and working on all things Outbreak: Shades of Horror! We wanted to come up for air and give you all a quick update on what we've been up to!

First, thank you to everyone who has played the Steam & Xbox Series X|S versions of the game, spread the word, and given us feedback! We are thrilled that everyone is playing and enjoying the ongoing Winter Wonderland and DINOBREAK crossover content! We will continue to update and improve the game based on player feedback.
Speaking of seasonal content, we're hard at work on the next seasonal event, which is coming this Spring! Once we're a little closer to deployment, we'll have more information to share.
We're still finalizing timelines and specifics, but there's a lot of other stuff coming up! Here's a small preview on top of the aforementioned seasonal content...
You can expect news regarding cross-platform multiplayer in the next few weeks.
New DLC content is being planned for release down the line.
Work continues on the PlayStation 5 version of the game. We'll share more details as we approach Spring!
Progress on Story Mode remains steady. This is another area we'll be talking more about in the Spring!

We want to take this time to thank everyone for their support and patience as we've continued to build out Outbreak: Shades of Horror. Game development is no easy task, and with a game as cutting edge as Shades of Horror that includes a large amount of content, features, and supported platforms, it's certainly challenging as a small indie team to craft.
We're extremely excited for you all to enjoy what we've been working so hard on, so we humbly ask for a little more time before we share and release our next wave of zombie-slaying mayhem.
Until next time, take care Survivors!
Hello Survivors!

notes.title: First, check out this new trailer

items.text: Today, we're going to break down the game's modes and hub area for you! The entirety of Outbreak: Shades of Horror can be experienced either solo or with up to three friends in co-op play over the network.
Cypress Reel

This playground is where you and your friends can group up and enter the game's various modes! You can select your character (across over 25 options!) and practice your controls, and you can also test your mettle at the obstacle course, improve your combat prowess, check out the game's various abilities and items, and so much more! Over time, Cypress Reel will expand with new content and special events!
Story mode

This is the survival horror campaign you're all expecting! Manage your resources and inventory, defeat menacing zombies, solve puzzles, and find notes as you explore colossal maps with awesome set-pieces and challenging encounters. Each episode will play out in explosive fashion, with multiple routes and many secrets to discover.
Invasion mode

A different flavor of survival. You'll face down endless enemy hordes as you attempt to both live and protect innocents. Before the game begins, you have a small period of time to fortify your base with turrets, traps, and more. Once the creatures appear, you'll need to annihilate hundreds of them without losing all of your lives or your civilians in the heat of battle. Multiple maps will be available!
Raid mode

This arcade-style experience is a blast. Scout sprawling, tight maps, take on the undead masses, and rescue trapped civilians before time runs out! As with the rest of Outbreak: Shades of Horror, Raid mode will be updated with new content and maps over time. Fans of our previous games may even find some fun nods to our history.
Mini-games

For some quick action, check out a selection of extra game types inspired by classic survival horror masterpieces. From Boss Rush, where you'll face a parade of tough monsters, to Collapse, where you'll flee a nasty subway on the brink of destruction, these scenarios are fun to play through over and over. Look forward to new mini-games as the game continues to grow!

We hope you're excited to experience the wild world of Cypress Ridge when Outbreak: Shades of Horror begins its descent onto Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and on PC via Steam this year! We will of course continue to update you with the latest information and more specific release timing as development continues. Thank you as always for your support and patience.
Railbreak Update 5 has been released with the following fixes on Steam.

Massive performance improvements for all hardware to remove remaining stutter, reduce overhead of having many enemies on screen, remove strange slowdown when the Kunoichi is on screen, and especially remove stutter during explosions or chaotic scenes.
DLSS 3.5 w/ Frame Generation is fully supported for compatible cards.
Screen percentage setting now behaves correctly on all hardware.
Player hair for all characters both looks better and has better performance.
Bounding boxes remaining after some enemy types have died have been fixed.
Minor balancing and other fixes across the game.
The dinosaurs are taking a break but Korrine can still see the future. Can you find them all?

releases.displayName: Railbreak Content Update One - Time Korrisis - Available Now!

items.text: Railbreak Content Update One (Patch 4) is LIVE NOW and features the following:
Korrine, the GlitchGoddess, is now available when selecting a character outside of Story Mode.
She uses special projectile attacks which are different than other characters.
Korrine's Plasma Cannon (Primary) consumes huge amounts of rifle rounds, but deals extreme damage over a large radius.

Her sidearm randomly alternates between elemental attacks and will randomly dismember different parts of enemies.: The Katana has the ability to trigger Korrine's Blessing, a super glitch that boosts scoring and damage, but also costs a terrible price as it'll force the player to endure a significant debuff.

As the Glitch Goddess, Korrine can also see into the future, so you may notice.... differences.... compared to other characters as you play the game. We assure you these changes are only visual, they probably can't hurt you, and only Korrine can see them.
The Time Korrisis Scoring Mode has been added to the game. Time Korrisis is a new way to play all of the content in Railbreak by turning the game into a Time Attack arcade game.
In Time Korrisis Mode, you will earn time by damaging and killing enemies, picking up weapons, and more. Headshots and limb shots award extra time.

If your timer runs out, you'll be instantly killed and will need to spend a life to continue.: This mode tracks your score separately across the game. More time remaining at the end of a level will yield a better rank. Good luck!
The character screen now clearly explains elemental damage and other traits.
Significant bug fixes, balancing changes, and graphics improvements across the game.

items.text: Hey Survivors!
Wow, we have a lot to talk about and a busy week ahead! Let's get to it!

notes.title: Railbreak VR & Tailbreak Crowdfunding Campaign is LIVE on Jan 30th @ 1PM ET!

items.text: Everyone has been asking for it, so we're doing it! Back our BackerKit Crowdfunding Campaign on Jan 30th @ 1PM ET to help make Railbreak VR on SteamVR and Tailbreak for both Railbreak and Railbreak VR happen!

Railbreak VR is exactly what it sounds like - a full native standalone implementation of SteamVR for all of Railbreak (and Tailbreak!). Experience the sights and sounds through your cutting edge VR headset as you take on the waves of glitched infected and dinos in the over-the-top insanity of the world of Railbreak!

Tailbreak is our first full sized story expansion pack for Railbreak. Bringing our dinos from Dinobreak into the world of Railbreak, you'll be fighting through a brand new story, new game modes, using new characters and weapons, and tons more! It's dinoriffic and we can't wait for it!

And we're going to have some absolutely INSANE giveaways! So go follow our Backerkit Crowdfunding page right now at http://www.railbreakvr.com so you don't miss your chance to back the project, and get in on these amazing giveaways!
We'll also be streaming all day starting at 1PM ET on twitch.tv/deaddropstudios !

notes.title: Railbreak Content Update One - Time Korrisis - Arrives on Jan 30th, 2024!

items.text: Our first content update is coming to Railbreak on all platforms on Jan 30th! Featuring the brand new Time Korrisis mode that is playable in every part of Railbreak, you'll be racing the clock as you fight through the undead to score more time and survive the nightmare! You can play this mode across all of Railbreak, so think of it as a new game plus!

We also have our new character, Korrine the Glitch Goddess, joining the cast! She's our first expert level character and she's challenging but incredibly fun to use. She uses all new projectile weapons (instead of the hitscan of other characters) and boasts the beastly Plasma Cannon, Glitched Sidearm, and the Katana which has the ability to trigger super glitches! Get ready for a brand new experience!
We'll be back on Tuesday with more news, but get ready for some crazy antics and follow the BackerKit Crowdfunding campaign now at http://www.railbreakvr.com so you're ready! (AND TELL YOUR FRIENDS!)
See you on Tuesday!
Hey Survivors,

Our latest patch for Railbreak is now live on Steam! This patch brings some meaty graphical enhancements to the game, and brings the title up to the 12GB size that was advertised on the store page since launch. If you encounter any instability, just reduce the Texture Quality setting in the Video Settings menu as that area received the biggest upgrade across the game.

Significant graphics improvements across the entire game. Hard drive space usage increased, however run-time RAM usage only appears slightly higher in-game as per our testing. This change does not affect the game's framerate.
Fixed an issue where the Sinden Lightgun Border would disappear on the Game Over screen.
Hey Survivors!
Good news! A few more glitches have been patched in the world of Railbreak on Steam! These patches are rolling out to all other platforms today as well!
Here's what we did, and don't forget to check the "Update Notes" button on the title screen for this complete list too! We have plenty more updates coming in the weeks ahead!
Added a "Compile Shaders" button to the Settings menu.
Added the Update Notes screen.
High scores now properly save in all parts of the game.
Added an option in Audio Settings to allow you to set the character's voice volume level independently.
Fixed numerous infrequent softlocks on Acts 2, 4, 5, and 6.
Added an option in Game Settings to allow you to specify additional wait time before moving to another area to make it easier to collect items.
Added an option to the Screen Filter Override in the Game Settings menu called "Never Switch", which will ensure no game overlays ever appear on screen.
Added an option to the Game Settings to specify larger bounding boxes on item pickups. This can only be set at the Main Menu.
Items can now only be picked up if they're visible to the player, and cannot be collected through walls or other surfaces anymore.
Improvements to eliminate a very infrequent situation where being grabbed by a zombie would remove your gun.
Additional performance improvements across the title.
Item highlights now appear at greater range.
